text:
Saturday morning. Half of Perth is at Bunnings.

Someone in the sausage sizzle line is typing "pool fence repair Joondalup" with sauce on their thumb.

Your customers search on weekends whether you work them or not.

Be there when they look.

Try it out. Ask ChatGPT for a good plumber in Midland.

Then look at who it names. Plenty of reviews. A website that says plainly what they do and where. Details that match everywhere.

No secret AI trick. Same homework that gets you found on Google.

A locksmith asks me how Google actually gets him clients.

Two moves.
Show up when someone's locked out and searching.
Keep showing up for the ones who aren't ready yet.

Everything else is decoration.
